reviews.title: Login problem using Facebook
reviews.text: I can’t login to Zamora using my facebook account. I’ve been using my facebook account to login to Zamora for years and no problems. My last shop here was last month and I wanted to shop today as I still have money in my Zamora wallet but opportunity I can’t login using my facebook account. Please fix this!

reviews.title: Unable to submit product reviews
reviews.text: Unable to submit product reviews because the navigation bar is blocking the submit review button at the bottom. This app is just getting frustrating and even more frustrating to use when their supposed to be the more premium version shopping app.

reviews.title: Scammer!!
reviews.text: Again I gave them chance and ordered but they sent me a defective product without even checking. I returned my order but after 10 days I didn’t get anything from them! I need to be the one to constantly ask for an update because they are not doing their job. And then today I found out my exchange is already sold out just because I was the one who checked my order in their list! They should’ve reserved that for me since I already filed the return&exchange 10 days ago! They are scamming people! And now I opted to cancel my request because how will they send me the exchange if it’s out of stock! But again I need to wait for an uncertain days weeks months just to get me refund! I suggest don’t order from zalora because they are not to be trusted! Scammer!!

reviews.title: Bad service
reviews.text: I ordered a pair of shoes and paid for shipping. They sent the wrong shoes and expected me to pay for the return fee which I shouldn’t have to since the fault was on their end. I returned the shoes and got a refund through their in app wallet and not back on my card. Wth is wrong with you??

reviews.title: After sale support is a joke! Just a money grab like any-other.
reviews.text: Great item, trash service. My order was cancelled for no reason, and I lost my vouchers and points in the process. What should’ve been a discounted gift is now an overpriced, late delivery. I even paid for VIP status, yet I’ve waited 6 days without a decent explanation. If this is how you treat VIPs, regular customers stand no chance at getting after-sales support. Absolute joke.

reviews.title: Bad experience with Zalora
reviews.text: To anyone considering buying Zalora vouchers, please think twice. They are non-refundable—even when the issue is caused by their system. Customers take the risk of trusting their service, yet there seems to be little accountability when problems occur. That feels unfair.

reviews.text: Customer service is almost non-existent. Also, I dont know why UNFORTUNATELY I am unable to make a product review on their app after a very frustrating experience. Do not buy from this app if you want a smooth and seamless transaction.

reviews.title: VERY POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE
reviews.text: They did not provide a tracking number to me, and didn’t deliver during the date they said they would. And now, three days later, I still haven’t talked to any human representative. All I could talk to was a chatbot which couldn’t respond to my queries. My order was supposed to be a Christmas gift to my husband. This app is NOT very reliable and has a VERY POOR customer service

reviews.title: Unacceptable Slow Delivery & Lack of Status Update
reviews.text: I get that some items are shipping from overseas, that it’s peak season, etc. But for my order to sit in “Ready for Shipping” for over a week without movement feels unacceptable. I also order from shops abroad via Shopee and Lazada but never had such poor app and delivery experience. You’re also interfaced with a bot and no human support whatsoever. It’s really frustrating!

reviews.title: Worst delivery service
reviews.text: Products are authentic, but they choose the worst delivery service in-country. Of all the delivery partners in the Philippines they just have to go with the worst, which is LBC. This particular delivery service doesn't bother to call or text you before delivery. And rider's phone number is not provided. They just assume you have nothing better to do but to wait for the package whole day. Sometimes when the riders are lazy due to the weather they just mark your package as failed attempt. Lazada no longer use LBC. But seems you guys still didn't learn the lesson or maybe the kickback is good enough.
